box: AMD Ryzen 5 5600G (Zen3) 6C/12T, 15.7 GB RAM, PCIe3 NVMe, Windows 11
binary: llama.cpp @1a064ab CPU/AVX2 (-march=native, clang/llvm-mingw), REUSED from M4 build
protocol: warm-steady, greedy, single-process warm reps (model loaded once). llama-bench samples_ts per-rep, rep0 = cold first-touch discarded.

thread_sweep_warm_median_tok_s.note: degenerate llama-bench single-repeated-token routing (minimal active expert set); reps confounded by cache-warming ramp; scaling ~FLAT past 4 cores and t12(SMT) no better -> not core-count-limited

diverse_source: llama-cli varied multi-topic prompt, real diverse expert routing, Generation t/s (load-excluded); artifacts/m4/evidence/probe-diverse.out footer

constraint_signals_during_generation.cpu_total_pct_range: ~40..52 (= ~6 logical of 12 busy = 6 physical cores saturated at -t 6)
constraint_signals_during_generation.thread_scaling: flat past 4 physical cores; SMT(t12) not better

binding_evidence: warm generation ~9.2-14 tok/s physically excludes 111 MB/token disk traffic (9.2*111MB=1.02GB/s == full drive, but measured disk during gen is <=0.66 GB/s and mostly lower -> cache-served); CPU worker threads pegged; disk has headroom.

gate_adr0002.threshold_rule_a: >= ~8 tok/s met (diverse 9.2; degenerate warm ~14) -> literal 'revive' band
gate_adr0002.resolution: rule (b) decides: a non-disk binder 'closes the streaming line here just as a compute wall does' (ADR-0002 Consequences b). The >=8 threshold's PREMISE (that reaching 8 means disk became the binder) is contradicted by the direct disk measurement -> streaming does NOT revive on this box.

overturns_m4.m4_direction_confirmed: decode is NOT disk-I/O-bound on this box -- CONFIRMED and strengthened (disk idle even under diverse routing).
overturns_m4.m4_number_overturned: M4's headline 4.3 tok/s was NOT the compute ceiling; it was a per-invocation cold-load artifact (each fresh llama-bench process re-faults ~14 GB). Warm-steady decode (model loaded once, server regime) is ~9.2 tok/s diverse / ~14 tok/s degenerate = 2.15x-3.3x higher.
overturns_m4.true_ceiling: compute/RAM-bandwidth at ~9-14 tok/s (workload-dependent), disk I/O has large headroom.

caveats: Single box/session, greedy. clang/mingw AVX2 build (per M4 build-env.json).
9.2 = llama-cli aggregate gen rate incl. thinking-phase warming; steady tail >= that. Rep-to-rep variance is high (10-19 degenerate) because model>RAM -> intermittent eviction/re-fault.

Warm-steady = single-process resident regime (a server loads once, then decodes many tokens). M4's 4.3 = cold/per-invocation regime, pathological for a server but real if the process reloads per request.

Streaming-thesis nuance: streaming (per-token expert paging) only binds if the ACTIVE expert working set exceeds RAM even warm. Diverse routing (9.2) did NOT trigger disk saturation, so the active set still fits here. A larger MoE, or a workload with a much wider hot-expert set, could still tip into the streaming regime -- untested here.
